seo.title: Privacy Policy | Collect by IKANISA
seo.description: Learn how Collect by IKANISA collects, uses, shares, protects, retains and deletes personal data.

hero.headline: Your data. Your choice. Your financial journey.
hero.supporting_copy: Collect uses personal data to operate your account, maintain accurate group-savings records, protect the platform, support credit readiness and connect you with financial products you choose to explore.
hero.trust_statement: We do not sell your personal data.

privacy_at_a_glance.title: We collect only what we need
privacy_at_a_glance.copy: We collect information needed to operate Collect, protect accounts, maintain financial records and deliver requested services.

privacy_at_a_glance.title: You control partner access
privacy_at_a_glance.copy: We do not send your credit-readiness documents to a bank, insurer or professional service provider without an appropriate legal basis and, where required, your instruction or consent.

privacy_at_a_glance.title: AI assists—it does not make final financial decisions
privacy_at_a_glance.copy: Collect may help organise information, identify missing documents and prepare applications. Banks and insurers retain final decision-making authority.

privacy_at_a_glance.title: You can access, correct, export or request deletion
privacy_at_a_glance.copy: You can manage certain information in the app or contact us to exercise your legal rights.

privacy_at_a_glance.title: Your funds are not held by Collect
privacy_at_a_glance.copy: Savings and financial products are provided through licensed financial institutions under their own regulatory obligations.

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
body: Collect is operated by:
sections.closing: For the personal data described in this Policy, IKANISA acts as the data controller unless another organisation is identified as the controller. A partner bank, insurer or professional service provider may act as a separate data controller for the products and services it provides.

sections.heading: 2. What this Policy covers
sections.intro: This Policy applies when you:
bullets: Use the Collect Android or iOS application
Create or join a savings group
Submit documents for a loan application
Express interest in an insurance product
Participate in a pilot, event or survey
Apply to become a bank, community or service partner
sections.closing: Partner banks, insurers and other external organisations may provide separate privacy notices for their services.

subsections.heading: Identity and verification information
bullets: Sanctions, fraud or compliance screening results

subsections.heading: Transaction and ledger information
bullets: MoMo and USSD confirmation and reconciliation
subsections.closing: Collect processes Rwanda MoMo and USSD confirmation evidence to maintain accurate contribution and ledger records. The public app does not read SMS inbox history.

subsections.heading: Credit-readiness information
bullets: Documents submitted to or received from service providers

subsections.heading: Insurance information
subsections.intro: Where you request an insurance service:
subsections.closing: The licensed insurer determines what information is required for underwriting and claims.

sections.heading: 4. How we obtain personal data
sections.intro: We may obtain information:
bullets: From your savings group or authorised group leader
From a partner bank or custodian
From a professional service provider you instruct us to coordinate
From identity, KYC, fraud or compliance providers
Automatically from your device when you use Collect
sections.closing: Where another person provides information about you, we may ask that person to confirm that they are authorised to do so.

sections.heading: 5. How we use personal data
sections.intro: We use personal data to:
bullets: Support savings goals and repayment schedules
Connect you to partner banks and insurers
Prevent fraud, misuse and unauthorised access
Send service messages and, where permitted, marketing communications
sections.closing: We do not use personal data for an unrelated purpose without an appropriate legal basis.

sections.heading: 6. Our legal bases
sections.intro: Depending on the service and your location, we process personal data because:
bullets: It is necessary to provide the service you requested
We must comply with a legal or regulatory obligation
Processing is necessary to protect you, another person or the platform
We or a partner have a legitimate interest that does not override your rights
Processing is necessary to establish, exercise or defend a legal claim
sections.closing: You may withdraw consent where processing depends on consent. Withdrawal does not affect processing that was lawful before withdrawal.

subsections.heading: Members of your group
subsections.intro: Group members and authorised leaders may see information required for group transparency, such as:
bullets: Your name or approved member identifier
Amount attributed to your group record
subsections.closing: Your private identity documents, business records and credit-readiness documents are not automatically visible to other members.

subsections.heading: Banks and financial institutions
subsections.intro: We may share information with a partner bank when you:
subsections.closing: The bank independently determines its KYC, eligibility, credit and retention requirements.

subsections.heading: Insurers
subsections.body: We share relevant information when you request a quotation, policy, premium-finance arrangement or claims support.

subsections.heading: Professional service providers
subsections.body: At your request, we may coordinate accountants, notaries, valuers, tax advisers, lawyers, business-plan specialists and registration providers.

subsections.heading: Technology and operational providers
subsections.closing: Providers may only use information according to their contract and applicable law.

subsections.heading: Regulators and public authorities
subsections.body: We may disclose data where legally required, including for regulatory supervision, fraud prevention, law enforcement, court orders or protection of legal rights.

subsections.heading: Business transfers
subsections.body: If IKANISA is restructured, merged, financed or sold, relevant data may be transferred subject to confidentiality, lawful processing and notice requirements.

sections.heading: 8. Data processing location
body: Collect serves Rwanda users. Service providers may process data outside Rwanda under appropriate legal, contractual, organisational and technical safeguards where applicable.

sections.heading: 9. AI and automated processing
sections.intro: Collect may use artificial intelligence to:
not_final_decision_for: Approve or reject an insurance claim
sections.closing: Final lending decisions remain with the partner lender. Insurance decisions remain with the licensed insurer. You may request human support, challenge inaccurate information and ask for correction of your records.
trust_commitments: Collect does not use customers' private financial documents to train publicly available AI models.

sections.heading: 10. How long we retain information
sections.intro: We keep personal data only for as long as needed to:
bullets: Operate your account and requested services
Maintain accurate group and transaction records
Meet KYC, AML, accounting, tax and regulatory requirements
sections.closing: Retention periods may differ by data type and partner. When a retention period ends, information is securely deleted, destroyed or irreversibly anonymised. Some records may be retained after account deletion where required by law, contract, fraud-prevention requirements or an active legal dispute.

sections.heading: 11. Your privacy rights
sections.intro: Depending on applicable law, you may request to:
bullets: Access personal data we hold about you
Receive a copy of your data
Export data in a structured format
Challenge a decision based solely on automated processing
Ask who has received your data
sections.closing: We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.

subsections.heading: Delete your account in the Collect app
Delete your account through the website
subsections.body: Use the public account-deletion page. You do not need to reinstall the app to submit a deletion request.

subsections.heading: What happens after a deletion request
bullets: We verify that the request comes from the account holder
We restrict ordinary use of the account
We delete or anonymise eligible personal data
We notify relevant service providers where required
subsections.service_target: We aim to respond within 30 days or within the period required by applicable law.

subsections.heading: What may need to happen first
bullets: Withdraw or transfer any available balance through the partner institution
Complete or cancel an active credit-readiness handoff
Address an unresolved dispute or fraud investigation

subsections.heading: What account deletion does not do
bullets: Cancel a subscription purchased through an app store
Remove records held independently by a bank or insurer

subsections.heading: Data we may retain
bullets: Protecting the rights of other group members
subsections.closing: Where a ledger entry affects other members, the transaction record may remain while your profile is deleted, restricted or de-identified as far as legally and technically possible. Deleted information may remain temporarily in secured backups until those backups are overwritten under our backup schedule.

sections.heading: 13. Security and trust
sections.intro: We use safeguards designed to protect personal data, including:
bullets: Encryption in transit and at rest
Segregation of customer and operational data
sections.risk_statement: No technology system is completely risk-free. If a breach affects your rights or legally requires notification, we will notify affected users and the appropriate authority.
trust_commitments: We do not sell personal data.
We do not hold customer deposits on Collect’s balance sheet.
We do not make final loan or insurance decisions.
We explain when a partner will receive your information.
We provide routes to access, correct and delete eligible data.
We limit group-member visibility to information needed for group operation.
We document important processing and partner access.

sections.heading: 14. Cookies and website analytics
sections.intro: We may use:
bullets: Marketing cookies, where consent is required
sections.closing: You can manage optional cookies through Cookie Settings. See the separate Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 15. Children
sections.body: Collect is not intended for people under the minimum age required by applicable law, except where a specific youth product is lawfully offered with verified consent from a parent or guardian. We do not knowingly create an ordinary financial account for a child without the required authorisation.

sections.heading: 16. Marketing
sections.body: You may opt out of marketing communications at any time by selecting Unsubscribe, changing app communication settings or contacting info@ikanisa.com. We may still send essential security, transaction, policy or service communications.

sections.heading: 17. Changes to this Policy
sections.body: We may update this Policy as Collect, our partners or legal requirements change. Material changes will be communicated through the app, website, email, SMS or another appropriate channel. The latest version will always show its effective date.

sections.heading: 18. Contact and complaints
sections.closing: You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data-protection authority.

terms.title: Terms of Use

seo.title: Terms of Use | Collect by IKANISA
seo.description: Read the rules governing your use of Collect by IKANISA, including savings, group, credit-readiness and partner services.

hero.headline: Clear rules for using Collect.
hero.supporting_copy: These Terms explain what Collect provides, what regulated partners provide, your responsibilities and the rules governing your use of the website, app and related services.

important_summary: Collect is a financial-technology and service-orchestration platform.
Collect does not accept deposits unless separately authorised.
Savings are held by licensed financial institutions.
Collect does not guarantee a loan, loan price or insurance cover.
Partner lenders make final credit decisions.
Licensed insurers issue policies and decide claims.
Group collateral may expose pledged savings if a borrower defaults.
You must provide accurate information and protect your account.
You may request account deletion, but deletion does not cancel financial obligations.

sections.heading: 1. About these Terms
body: By creating an account or using Collect, you agree to these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
additional_terms_may_include: Rwanda MoMo and USSD contribution terms
sections.priority_rule: Where a partner’s regulated product terms conflict with these general Terms, the partner’s product agreement governs that product.

sections.heading: 2. Who may use Collect
sections.intro: You may use Collect if you:
bullets: Have legal capacity to enter into an agreement
Are not prohibited from using the service by law

sections.heading: 3. What Collect provides
bullets: Mobile-app access and MoMo USSD handoff
sections.closing: Features may differ by country, partner, device or pilot programme.

sections.heading: 4. What Collect does not provide
sections.intro: Unless separately licensed and expressly stated, Collect is not:
bullets: A legal, tax, accounting or investment adviser

sections.heading: 5. Your account
sections.intro: You must:
bullets: Protect passwords, PINs and verification codes
Notify us promptly of suspected misuse
Use only your own identity and authorised accounts
sections.closing: You are responsible for activity conducted through your account unless the activity resulted from a failure for which Collect is legally responsible. We may require additional verification before processing a sensitive instruction.

sections.heading: 6. Savings and payments
body: Collect may prepare a MoMo USSD handoff, reconcile confirmed payments and display contributions.
You authorise each transfer in your banking app; Collect does not initiate, sign or execute it.
Customer funds are transferred to and held or processed through licensed financial institutions.
sections.closing: You must verify transfer references and notify us promptly if a record appears incorrect. Collect ledger information does not replace the official account record held by the regulated financial institution.

sections.heading: 7. Group savings
member_obligations: Make contributions according to the agreed schedule
Avoid coercion, fraud or misuse of group funds
sections.closing: Collect may provide technology and records but does not replace the group’s governance obligations.

sections.heading: 8. Group collateral
sections.intro: Where a partner bank offers a group-backed loan:
bullets: The group must approve the collateral arrangement
The pledged amount and enforcement rules must be documented
The individual borrower remains responsible for repayment
Pledged group savings may be applied following default
Members must understand the potential loss before consenting
sections.closing: Saving through Collect does not automatically create collateral or guarantee credit. Collect will not describe savings as pledged until the partner bank and relevant group have completed the required documentation.

sections.heading: 9. Credit Readiness-as-a-Service
collect_may_support: Packaging a file for partner review
credit_readiness_is_not: A credit score issued by a credit bureau
sections.closing: The partner bank conducts its own analysis and may request additional information.

sections.heading: 10. AI-assisted services
body: AI output may contain errors and must be reviewed.
You remain responsible for checking information before submission. Collect may require human review before handing a file to a partner.
Collect does not use AI as the final authority for loan approval, insurance underwriting or claims decisions.

sections.heading: 11. Professional service providers
sections.closing: Unless expressly stated, these providers are independent. Collect is not responsible for professional advice delivered independently by the provider, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

sections.heading: 12. Loans
sections.closing: Deleting Collect, leaving a savings group or changing a telephone number does not cancel a loan. You must read and accept the partner lender’s agreement before borrowing.

sections.heading: 13. Insurance
sections.intro: Insurance products are issued by licensed insurers.
sections.closing: Collect may support product discovery, premium workflows, digital records, reminders and claims notification. A premium payment does not create cover until confirmed according to the insurer’s terms.

sections.heading: 14. Fees
sections.body: Collect will display applicable fees before you accept a paid service.
sections.zero_fee_clarification: A zero-fee savings statement applies only to the specific user charge described. A MoMo provider may impose separate charges unless waived under the product terms.

sections.heading: 15. Acceptable use
sections.intro: You must not use Collect to:
sections.closing: We may investigate suspected misuse and cooperate with authorised authorities.

sections.heading: 16. Suspension and restriction
may_apply_to: Respond to a partner or regulator
sections.closing: Where appropriate, we will explain the reason and provide a route to challenge the action. Suspension of Collect does not suspend obligations owed to a bank, insurer, group or service provider.

sections.heading: 17. Closing or deleting your account
request_channels: In the app under Settings → Privacy and Security → Delete Account
before_deletion_you_may_need_to: Complete or cancel an active application
sections.closing: We may retain records where legally required. Eligible data will be deleted or anonymised according to the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 18. Intellectual property
body: Collect, IKANISA, software, interfaces, trademarks, designs and original content are owned by or licensed to IKANISA.
We grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable right to use Collect for its intended purpose.
You may not copy, reverse engineer, resell, modify or commercially exploit Collect without written permission.
You retain ownership of documents and content you provide, but grant us permission to process them to deliver requested services.

sections.heading: 19. Service availability
sections.closing: We may change or discontinue features, subject to applicable notice and contractual requirements.

sections.heading: 20. Statements and financial information
sections.body: Balances, readiness indicators, projections and status information displayed by Collect may depend on data received from partners. You should report errors promptly.

sections.heading: 21. Limitation of liability
sections.non_exclusion: Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded.
to_extent_permitted_collect_not_responsi: An insurer’s underwriting or claim decision
False information supplied by a user
Network or partner outages outside our control
Losses caused by unauthorised account access resulting from your failure to protect credentials
sections.legal_review_note: Any further liability limits must be reviewed and adapted by legal counsel for each operating jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 22. Privacy
sections.body: Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, retain and delete personal data.

sections.heading: 23. Complaints
sections.closing: A complaint concerning a bank, loan or insurance policy may also need to be submitted to the relevant regulated partner. You retain the right to contact the relevant regulator, data-protection authority or court.

sections.heading: 24. Changes to these Terms
sections.closing: We will provide reasonable notice of material changes. Continuing to use Collect after the effective date means you accept the updated Terms, except where law requires a different form of consent.

sections.heading: 25. Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Rwanda. Disputes will be handled by the competent Rwandan court or dispute-resolution forum, subject to mandatory legal rights.

hero.headline: Delete your Collect account.

delete_without_app.heading: Delete without the app

fields.name: acknowledgement
fields.label: I understand that deleting my Collect account does not cancel any loan, insurance policy, group obligation or other product provided by a third party.

steps: We review pending transactions and group responsibilities.
We tell you if any action is required.
We delete or anonymise eligible data.
We retain only records required by law or necessary for security, fraud prevention, disputes and regulatory compliance.
We confirm when the process is complete.

Download any statements you wish to keep

bullets: Records needed to resolve disputes or legal claims

partner_products.heading: Products provided by partners
partner_products.copy: To cancel an insurance policy or discuss a loan, contact the relevant insurer, lender or other provider. Collect cannot cancel an independently provided regulated product on the partner’s behalf unless the partner has expressly enabled that workflow.

sections.closing: You are responsible for activity conducted through your account unless the activity resulted from a failure for which Collect is legally responsible. We may require additional verification before processing a sensitive instruction.

sections.heading: 6. Savings and payments
body: Collect may prepare a MoMo USSD handoff, reconcile confirmed payments and display contributions.
You authorise each transfer in your banking app; Collect does not initiate, sign or execute it.
Customer funds are transferred to and held or processed through licensed financial institutions.
sections.closing: You must verify transfer references and notify us promptly if a record appears incorrect. Collect ledger information does not replace the official account record held by the regulated financial institution.

sections.heading: 7. Group savings
member_obligations: Make contributions according to the agreed schedule
Avoid coercion, fraud or misuse of group funds
sections.closing: Collect may provide technology and records but does not replace the group’s governance obligations.

sections.heading: 8. Group collateral
sections.intro: Where a partner bank offers a group-backed loan:
bullets: The group must approve the collateral arrangement
The pledged amount and enforcement rules must be documented
The individual borrower remains responsible for repayment
Pledged group savings may be applied following default
Members must understand the potential loss before consenting
sections.closing: Saving through Collect does not automatically create collateral or guarantee credit. Collect will not describe savings as pledged until the partner bank and relevant group have completed the required documentation.

sections.heading: 9. Credit Readiness-as-a-Service
collect_may_support: Packaging a file for partner review
credit_readiness_is_not: A credit score issued by a credit bureau
sections.closing: The partner bank conducts its own analysis and may request additional information.

sections.heading: 10. AI-assisted services
body: AI output may contain errors and must be reviewed.
You remain responsible for checking information before submission. Collect may require human review before handing a file to a partner.
Collect does not use AI as the final authority for loan approval, insurance underwriting or claims decisions.

sections.heading: 11. Professional service providers
sections.closing: Unless expressly stated, these providers are independent. Collect is not responsible for professional advice delivered independently by the provider, except where applicable law provides otherwise.

sections.heading: 12. Loans
sections.closing: Deleting Collect, leaving a savings group or changing a telephone number does not cancel a loan. You must read and accept the partner lender’s agreement before borrowing.

sections.heading: 13. Insurance
sections.intro: Insurance products are issued by licensed insurers.
sections.closing: Collect may support product discovery, premium workflows, digital records, reminders and claims notification. A premium payment does not create cover until confirmed according to the insurer’s terms.

sections.heading: 14. Fees
sections.body: Collect will display applicable fees before you accept a paid service.
sections.zero_fee_clarification: A zero-fee savings statement applies only to the specific user charge described. A MoMo provider may impose separate charges unless waived under the product terms.

sections.heading: 15. Acceptable use
sections.intro: You must not use Collect to:
sections.closing: We may investigate suspected misuse and cooperate with authorised authorities.

sections.heading: 16. Suspension and restriction
may_apply_to: Respond to a partner or regulator
sections.closing: Where appropriate, we will explain the reason and provide a route to challenge the action. Suspension of Collect does not suspend obligations owed to a bank, insurer, group or service provider.

sections.heading: 17. Closing or deleting your account
request_channels: In the app under Settings → Privacy and Security → Delete Account
before_deletion_you_may_need_to: Complete or cancel an active application
sections.closing: We may retain records where legally required. Eligible data will be deleted or anonymised according to the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 18. Intellectual property
body: Collect, IKANISA, software, interfaces, trademarks, designs and original content are owned by or licensed to IKANISA.
We grant you a limited, personal, non-exclusive, revocable right to use Collect for its intended purpose.
You may not copy, reverse engineer, resell, modify or commercially exploit Collect without written permission.
You retain ownership of documents and content you provide, but grant us permission to process them to deliver requested services.

sections.heading: 19. Service availability
sections.closing: We may change or discontinue features, subject to applicable notice and contractual requirements.

sections.heading: 20. Statements and financial information
sections.body: Balances, readiness indicators, projections and status information displayed by Collect may depend on data received from partners. You should report errors promptly.

sections.heading: 21. Limitation of liability
sections.non_exclusion: Nothing in these Terms excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded.
to_extent_permitted_collect_not_responsi: An insurer’s underwriting or claim decision
False information supplied by a user
Network or partner outages outside our control
Losses caused by unauthorised account access resulting from your failure to protect credentials
sections.legal_review_note: Any further liability limits must be reviewed and adapted by legal counsel for each operating jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 22. Privacy
sections.body: Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, retain and delete personal data.

sections.heading: 23. Complaints
sections.closing: A complaint concerning a bank, loan or insurance policy may also need to be submitted to the relevant regulated partner. You retain the right to contact the relevant regulator, data-protection authority or court.

sections.heading: 24. Changes to these Terms
sections.closing: We will provide reasonable notice of material changes. Continuing to use Collect after the effective date means you accept the updated Terms, except where law requires a different form of consent.

sections.heading: 25. Governing law
sections.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Rwanda. Disputes will be handled by the competent Rwandan court or dispute-resolution forum, subject to mandatory legal rights.

hero.headline: Delete your Collect account.

page.important_notice: Deleting your Collect account does not automatically cancel any loan or insurance policy, remove a repayment obligation or remove records independently held by a regulated partner.

delete_in_app.heading: Delete in the app

delete_without_app.heading: Delete without the app
delete_without_app.copy: Complete the form below. You do not need to reinstall the app to submit a deletion request.

what_happens_next.heading: What happens next
steps: We review pending transactions and group responsibilities.
We tell you if any action is required.
We delete or anonymise eligible data.
We retain only records required by law or necessary for security, fraud prevention, disputes and regulatory compliance.
We confirm when the process is complete.
what_happens_next.service_target: We aim to respond within 30 days or within the period required by applicable law.

before_we_can_complete_deletion.heading: You may need to complete these steps first

data_we_may_retain.heading: Data we may retain
bullets: Records needed to resolve disputes or legal claims
Ledger entries needed to protect the rights of other group members
data_we_may_retain.closing: Where a ledger entry affects other members, the transaction record may remain while your profile is deleted, restricted or de-identified as far as legally and technically possible. Deleted data may remain temporarily in secured backups until those backups are overwritten.

partner_products.heading: Products provided by partners
partner_products.copy: To cancel an insurance policy or discuss a loan, contact the relevant insurer, lender or other provider. Collect cannot cancel an independently provided regulated product on the partner’s behalf unless the partner has expressly enabled that workflow.
